title: The Path of Mantra — Yoga, Tantra, and Shakti Sadhana
author: Giovanni Dienstmann
description: *The* *Path of Mantra* podcast exists to help those wanting to start or deepen a Mantra practice. Here I share my hard earned insights and knowledge from years of practice under a traditional mantra Guru, as well as from self-study and experimentation. I am a *sadhaka* (spiritual practitioner) moved by the intention of helping fellow seekers along the way. This is part of my dharma. This project is non-sectarian. Whether your interest in mantras is about personal growth, healing, *siddhis*, manifestation, bhakti yoga, or spiritual liberation, you are welcome to join and learn.
